tasks.short: Give scientific guidance on micro and nanoscale processes.

steps.what: Find actual micro and nanoscale process evidence for the technical question
Evaluate the process evidence and provide scientific or technical guidance
Write and check the actual scientific guidance record
Save the checked scientific guidance record

tasks.design: Configure native document search and source links in {DOCS}, then reuse verified document references in the engineer's existing guidance record. The engineer reads the evidence, gives the advice and writes and checks the actual recommendations and limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable process revision and repeating its references can interrupt technical advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search filters, controlled links and document fields can reduce retrieval and repeated metadata entry.
tasks.still_hard: Chemical, analytical and biological effects at small scales do not follow from a document match alone.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises when evidence does not support advice for this material and scale.
tasks.altitude: Fewer document searches; advisory responsibility remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document search and linked template fields can reduce finding and re-entering source references; they do not provide scientific judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual technical advice and its existing record. Oral-only guidance has no record-writing share: reweight to observed work instead of creating a note requirement.

Question comes from the requesting colleague; document owners supply actual process identifier, revision and scope. The engineer verifies source relevance in s1 and supplies actual advice in s2-s3; absent metadata is searched and entered manually.
Test native configuration before code; already indexed references earn no saving. The 20 percent s3 reduction only concerns repeated source and context fields, not the actual advice.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The same-system save is one percent fully retained. The existing note check supplies the action gate without a new approval step.
unknowns: How often is guidance documented today?
Are process revisions searchable by actual identifiers?
research_questions: Does native search shorten source finding while leaving technical reading and advice unchanged?

incremental.description: Maintain process search filters and linked fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final scientific guidance record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10*0.40 + 9*0.20 = 5.8, minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.3. With half the document retrieval and repeated fields eligible, 2.9 minus 0.5 = 2.4. Actual advice is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review current nanotechnology research or production work and decide assignments
Enter and check actual technician work assignments
Commit the checked actual technician work assignments
Supervise technicians or technologists, inspect work and resolve actual nanotechnology problems
Write and check actual supervision outcomes and follow-up requirements
Save the checked actual supervision outcome record

tasks.design: Reuse current protocol and work-item references in existing assignment fields in {PROJECT}. The engineer chooses and checks assignments, commits them, supervises actual work and records outcomes only after observing that work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing assignments can repeat work-item and protocol reference fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked task fields can reuse those references.
tasks.still_hard: Safe technique, coaching and intervention depend on actual technician work.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises weak technique and decides when to intervene.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project systems can reuse existing protocol and work-item identifiers in assignments; observing and supervising nanotechnology work remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's actual supervision and existing assignment/outcome records. Technician labour is not in this denominator; do not add a new supervisory report where none exists.

Work-item owners provide actual identifier and status, protocol owners the current revision, and the engineer chooses technician and instruction in s1-s2. Missing fields are entered manually; actual outcomes are supplied by the engineer only after s4.
Test native linked fields before code. Existing automated assignment population earns no saving. Only repeated reference entry in s2 changes, not assignment judgement or actual supervision.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save/commit actions are each one percent fully retained; existing assignment and note checks provide the gates without added self-approval work.
unknowns: Are assignments already linked to controlled protocols?
What records does the supervisor actually write?
research_questions: Is enough reference entry duplicated to justify changing assignment configuration?

incremental.description: Check assignment-reference configuration after protocol changes.

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked final technician work assignments including exact people, instructions and project destination; edits void approval
s5 checked final actual supervision outcome record and project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 9*0.20 = 1.8 minus 0.5 upkeep = 1.3. With only half the assignment fields repeated, 0.9 minus 0.5 = 0.4. Observation, decisions and actual outcome notes remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find and assess actual research sources on the nanotechnology topic
Design and conduct nanotechnology experiments and inspect actual materials
Transfer actual experiment data from instrument software {OTHER} into analysis tables
Interpret nanoscale effects and assess the research hypothesis
Write and check the actual nanotechnology research record
Save the checked final nanotechnology research record

tasks.design: Configure scholarly search in the research database {OTHER} and test native instrument exports before building a small checked import into {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still assesses sources, conducts research, verifies sample and unit mappings and interprets the actual experiment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches and instrument-to-analysis re-entry can consume research time.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved search filters and deterministic export mappings can remove retrieval and transcription work.
tasks.still_hard: Nanoscale sample behaviour, instrument artefacts and causal interpretation require experimental skill.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes a real effect from preparation or measurement artefacts.
tasks.altitude: Less data re-entry; research decisions and interpretation remain with the engineer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scholarly databases support saved searches and instrument software can export measurements for checked deterministic import; applicability depends on actual export formats.

assumptions: Boundary includes research through its actual research record, not downstream manufacturing. The topic may involve dispersion, heat, fluorescence or other nanoscale phenomena; no generic model chooses the experiment.

Scholarly database {OTHER} supplies indexed source metadata. Instruments in s2 produce actual sample identifier, timestamp, channel, value, unit and calibration reference; the engineer captures actual observations and verifies mappings in s3. Missing exports or calibration references stay manual, including sample matching.

Test native exports and analysis imports first. Existing solver or instrument runtime is not human effort; already imported measurements earn no saving. Research reading, methods and interpretation remain human.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The final save has one percent fully retained time and the existing record check supplies its gate.
unknowns: Which instruments export sample identifiers and calibrated units?
How much data is manually transcribed today?
research_questions: Can actual exports reproduce the manual analysis table with no sample or unit ambiguity?

incremental.description: Maintain export mappings and search filters; investigate schema changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final nanotechnology research record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15*0.30 search + 15*0.60 transcription = 13.5, minus 1.5 upkeep = 12. If half the searches and measurements are eligible, 6.75 minus 1.5 = 5.25. Experiments and interpretation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report and present nanosystems engineering results.

steps.what: Verify actual engineering results and select recommendations to communicate
Populate engineering result tables and charts for reports and presentations
Write reports or presentation explanations of engineering results and recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft explanations of verified engineering results
loop.input: Verified results, limitations and chosen recommendations with source references
loop.check: Engineer checks scientific meaning, omitted limitations, unsupported causal claims and each recommendation against the actual results
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns drafting to the engineer
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native tables and fixed report headings first; varied research explanations cannot be filled from fixed fields alone

steps.what: Check final report or presentation content, disclosure scope and recipient list
Save the checked final engineering communication version
Send the checked engineering report or presentation to the actual recipients
Deliver presentations or discuss engineering results in actual program reviews

tasks.design: Use linked tables and charts in {DOCS} before adding a bounded drafting loop for explanations of verified engineering results. The engineer checks the exact final communication before its separate save and send, then delivers the presentation or participates in the review personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineering report preparation can repeat result tables and explanations across documents and slides.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked charts handle structured content; a bounded draft can start variable prose from verified sources.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing justified recommendations and responding to program-review questions remain engineering work.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer explains uncertainty and defends recommendations under questioning.
tasks.altitude: Less result copying and first-draft prose; scientific and disclosure authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked document charts can reuse verified result rows and a bounded language model can draft explanations that require scientific checking.

assumptions: Boundary covers a provisional mix of actual reports, presentations and program reviews. Reweight for report-only or review-only work; no report is added to a purely oral review.

The engineer verifies actual result identifier, condition, value, unit, uncertainty and source version in s1. Missing or inconsistent rows are assembled manually in s1 before s2; native links only populate charts from verified rows. No upstream capture is assumed free.

Actual recipients may include external research partners, hence s6 external authority; for internal-only distribution use internal authority. Existing disclosure rights are required, not invented. No draft is sent before s4 checks its final content and destination.

Test native tables, charts and fixed report headings first. Already-linked content earns no saving; remaining s3 time includes correcting generated meaning. Shares are provisional, not measured baselines; same-system save and routine send are each one percent fully retained.
unknowns: Are verified result rows already linked into reports?
What is the actual report, presentation and review mix?
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce preparation time after counting all scientific corrections?

already_counted.description: Scientific checking and correction of generated explanations remains inside s3.

incremental.description: Maintain result links, template mappings and drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final engineering communication and exact document destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final engineering communication and exact recipients; any edit or recipient change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 chart entry + 24*0.40 prose = 24.6; subtract 2 upkeep = 22.6. If half of chart entry and prose are eligible, 12.3 minus 2 = 10.3. Presentations, review dialogue and save/send actions retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer retains research, supervisory and scientific communication authority while reducing repeated information handling.
role.ambitious_version: Decision rights stay unchanged; validate reduced transcription and drafting on actual nanosystems work.
